decisions.reason: The same source message already establishes the dedicated-page model and the three current locations in this Requirement; no additional change is required from the selector update.
The selector options do not change the master site's national role, positioning, or booking allocation.
Naming current selector options does not change the reusable-template behavior for adding future locations without redesign.
The source preserves location selection but does not change whether operational locations use separate Wix websites and accounts.
The same source message already includes the Location Selector in the homepage section list; the named options do not alter the section-composition Requirement.
The selector's current location options do not change the visual reference, layout, navigation style, or cross-location design consistency.
Location-selection behavior does not change the brand name, colors, consistency, or national positioning.
The location selector and its options do not modify the mobile-friendly design requirement.
Frontend location choices do not alter the existing isolation of bookings, revenue, sales, calendars, accounts, or reporting.
The selector update does not change separate payout handling or the payment-isolation mechanism.
Allowing visitors to choose a location does not change Wix as the booking platform or sibling location sites as the booking hosts.
The selector behavior and current option list do not necessarily alter the SEO-preservation requirement for the Bay Area migration.
